title: Audit Log is in every list's and page's three-dot menu
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Open the three-dot menu beside New Tier.
  3. Press Esc.
  4. Open tier A's three-dot menu on the Tiers list.
  5. Press Esc.
  6. Click tier A's row on the Tiers list.
  7. Open the page's three-dot menu.
  8. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  9. Open the three-dot menu beside New Matrix.
  10. Press Esc.
  11. Click matrix A's name on the Matrices list.
  12. Open the page's three-dot menu.
  13. Open Settings › Categories.
  14. Open the three-dot menu beside New Category.
  15. Press Esc.
  16. Click category A's row.
  17. Open the page's three-dot menu.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Tiers list shows.

Step 2:

  • The menu lists Audit Log.

Step 3:

  • The menu closes.

Step 4:

  • Tier A's row menu lists Audit Log.

Step 5:

  • The menu closes.

Step 6:

  • Tier A's page opens.

Step 7:

  • Tier A's page menu lists Audit Log.

Step 8:

  • The Matrices list shows.

Step 9:

  • The menu lists Audit Log.

Step 10:

  • The menu closes.

Step 11:

  • Matrix A's page opens.

Step 12:

  • Matrix A's page menu lists Audit Log.

Step 13:

  • The Categories page shows.

Step 14:

  • The menu lists Audit Log.

Step 15:

  • The menu closes.

Step 16:

  • Category A's page opens.

Step 17:

  • Category A's page menu lists Audit Log and Delete.
